name: Hadimba Temple
description: Ancient cave temple dedicated to Hidimba Devi, surrounded by towering deodar cedars. The 1553 pagoda-style wooden structure is one of Himachal's most photographed buildings.

name: Jogini Waterfall
description: Short 3km trek from Vashisht village to a 150-foot waterfall through apple orchards.

name: Mall Road
description: Main commercial strip with shops, restaurants, and the Tibetan market.

name: Manu Temple
description: Ancient temple dedicated to sage Manu, believed to be the creator of the world. One of the oldest temples in the region.

name: Naggar Castle
description: Medieval stone and wood castle built in 1460, now a heritage hotel with panoramic valley views and an art gallery.

name: Nehru Kund
description: Natural spring named after Jawaharlal Nehru who used to drink water from this spring. On the Leh highway.

name: Nicholas Roerich Art Gallery
description: Gallery showcasing works of Russian artist Nicholas Roerich who lived in Naggar. Beautiful Himalayan art collection.

name: Old Manali
description: Bohemian village across the Manalsu stream — cafés, bakeries, live music, hippie shops, and Manu Temple.

name: Solang Valley Ropeway
description: Gondola ride to 3,780m with panoramic Himalayan views. Paragliding, skiing (winter), and zorbing available at the base.

name: Vashisht Hot Springs
description: Natural sulphur hot springs inside a centuries-old temple complex.

name: Dhankar Monastery
description: Perched on a 1,000-ft cliff at 12,774 ft. Former capital of Spiti with stunning valley views.

name: Hikkim Post Office
description: World's highest post office at 14,400 ft. Send postcards with a unique stamp from this remote village.

name: Key Monastery
description: Largest and oldest monastery in Spiti Valley. Perched on a cliff at 4,166m.

name: Kunzum Pass
description: High mountain pass at 15,060 ft connecting Kullu and Spiti. Temple at the top with prayer flags.

name: Pin Valley National Park
description: Cold desert national park home to snow leopard, Himalayan ibex, and rare Himalayan plants.

name: Tabo Monastery
description: Founded in 996 AD, one of the oldest continuously operating Buddhist monasteries. Called "Ajanta of the Himalayas" for murals.

name: Eastern Group (Jain Temples)
description: Parsvanath, Adinath, and Ghantai Jain temples with exquisite carvings. Less crowded than western group.

name: Raneh Falls
description: Volcanic canyon with 5 km gorge of crystalline granite in vibrant colors. Spectacular during monsoon.

name: Sound & Light Show
description: Evening show narrating the history of Chandela kings and the temples, held at the Western Group.

name: Western Group of Temples
description: UNESCO World Heritage masterpiece. Kandariya Mahadeva, Lakshmana, and Vishwanath temples with erotic sculptures (10th-11th century).

name: Auli Ropeway (Gondola)
description: Asia's longest cable car at 4 km connecting Joshimath to Auli. Spectacular views of Nanda Devi.

name: Auli Ski Slopes
description: India's premier ski destination with slopes between 8,200-10,000 ft. Nanda Devi backdrop.

name: Gorson Bugyal
description: Alpine meadow at 10,000 ft with stunning views of Nanda Devi and Trishul. Easy trek from Auli.

name: Corbett Museum (Gurney House)
description: Former home of Jim Corbett with his belongings, photographs, and hunting memorabilia.

name: Garjia Devi Temple
description: Temple perched on a large rock in the middle of Kosi River. Beautiful setting with wildlife nearby.

name: Jim Corbett Jeep Safari
description: India's oldest national park (1936). Tiger safari across 5 zones — Bijrani, Jhirna, Dhikala, Durga Devi, Sitabani.

name: Atal Tunnel (Rohtang)
description: World's longest highway tunnel above 10,000 ft at 9.02 km. Engineering marvel connecting Manali to Lahaul.

name: Sissu Waterfall
description: Spectacular waterfall visible from the highway in Lahaul. Frozen in winter, thundering in summer.

name: Trilokinath Temple
description: Sacred to both Hindus and Buddhists. White marble Shiva idol worshipped as Avalokiteshvara by Buddhists.

name: Gira Waterfalls
description: 30-meter waterfall in Dangs forest, spectacular during monsoon. 50 km from Saputara.

name: Saputara Lake
description: Boating lake in the centre of town. Paddle boats, row boats, and speed boats available.

name: Saputara Ropeway
description: Cable car ride over the lake and hills with panoramic Western Ghats views. Best at sunset.

name: Barmer Handicraft Market
description: Famous for hand-block printing, mirror work embroidery, and wooden crafts of the Thar Desert.

name: Kiradu Temples
description: Cluster of five ruined temples from 11th-12th century. Called "Khajuraho of Rajasthan" for intricate carvings.

name: Tirthan Valley Trek
description: UNESCO World Heritage park with pristine forests, 375 fauna species. Home to Western Tragopan pheasant.

name: Wildlife Observation Points
description: Designated spots for observing Himalayan brown bear, snow leopard, musk deer, and blue sheep.

name: Mahaparinirvana Temple
description: Sacred site where Buddha attained Mahaparinirvana (passed away). 6-meter reclining Buddha statue.

name: Ramabhar Stupa
description: Stupa marking the cremation site of Lord Buddha. Peaceful park setting with meditation areas.

name: Rainbow Falls
description: Waterfall reached after crossing two root bridges. Rainbow visible in the spray on sunny mornings.

name: Single Decker Living Root Bridge
description: Ancient living root bridge of Tyrna in the Nongriat village area. Requires 3,000+ steps trek down and up.

name: Parvati Bagh
description: A wildflower meadow at ~4,200m on the route between Kunsa and Bhim Dwar, named for Parvati. Brahma Kamal blooms here through July and August.

name: Shrikhand Mahadev Shivling
description: A 75-foot vertical natural rock formation revered as the Shrikhand Mahadev Shivling. Standing at 5,227m it is one of India's highest pilgrim destinations.

name: Mehao Wildlife Sanctuary
description: Remote sanctuary in the Mishmi Hills. Home to Mishmi takin and hoolock gibbons. Birding paradise.

name: Doodhpathri Meadow
description: Bowl-shaped meadow meaning "Valley of Milk". Shaliganga stream meanders through vast green carpet of flowers.

name: Mawjymbuin Cave
description: Cave with massive stalagmite shaped like a Shiva lingam. In the wettest place on Earth.

name: Bhimakali Temple
description: One of the 51 Shakti Peethas. Spectacular Himalayan wooden temple architecture with silver doors. Kinner Kailash views.
